2105-4742-5144-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-4742-5144-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-4742-5144-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Ephemerate from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Ephemerate from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

81-512-4644.easyPrerequisites:
Kami of Whispered Hopes and Tidewater Minion do not have summoning sickness.
Kami of Whispered Hopes has power 2 or greater.
81-512-4644.description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Tidewater Minion and Kami of Whispered Hopes, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Tidewater Minion ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
81-512-4644.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Kami of Whispered Hopes's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

730-1479-2841-8102.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Windswept Heath.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
730-1479-2841-8102.description:
Fetch a land using Windswept Heath.
When the fetched land enters, Emeria Angel and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Emeria Angel trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Emeria Angel triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

4038-4613-7426-7854.easyPrerequisites:
There is at least one +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta does not have summoning sickness.
4038-4613-7426-7854.description:
Activate Berta using Tender Wildguide's ability by tapping them, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta's second ability triggers, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Berta using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping them, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta's second ability triggers, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

206-3259-7357.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
206-3259-7357.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Pugnacious Pugilist as attackers.
Pugnacious Pugilist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3000-3899-4359.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more loyalty counters on it

1170-1177-5078-5645.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Narset by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to look at the top four cards of your library, then reveal Sensei's Divining Top and put it into your hand.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Narset.
Repeat.

4050-5010-6247-7028.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {B}.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and High-Society Hunter trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Resolve the High-Society Hunter trigger, causing you to draw Golgari Thug from your library.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {1}.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2034-3490-4017-6823.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-4017-6823.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

1818-2173-5010-6797.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
1818-2173-5010-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
When Golgari Thug enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

625-1978-3151.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Elves.
625-1978-3151.description:
Cause Elvish Archdruid to become an artifact using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Elvish Archdruid.
Repeat from step 2.

3054-3188-3416-5670.easyPrerequisites: You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
3054-3188-3416-5670.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the Vampire and Oathsworn Vampire enter, Social Climber triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader twice by paying 2 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire and the Vampire token, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to an artifact creature you control that does not have summoning sickness
attached to the same creature that has Bigger on the Inside attached

4222-5343.description:
Activate the creature with Bigger on the Inside and Freed from the Real attached by tapping it, adding {U}{U} and causing the next spell you cast this turn to have cascade.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping the creature.
Repeat.

539-2921-5649-6517.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a 4/4 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

67-2781-5231.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reveillark.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Reveillark.
When Reveillark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian and up to one other creature with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

851-2457-4289-4927.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

790-3681-5076.notablePrerequisites: A player has a number of cards in hand that is greater than or equal to 10 minus the lowest amount of poison counters an opponent has.
790-3681-5076.description:
Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hand and then draw a number of cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way.
Kederekt Parasite triggers for each card drawn this way, giving each opponent a poison counter for each card they drew.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters

1809-2103-2665.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Returned Pastcaller.
1809-2103-2665.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Returned Pastcaller.
When the token Returned Pastcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1323-3143-4644-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Experiment Kraj and Xavier Sal do not have summoning sickness.
Devoted Druid and Tidewater Minion each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
You control at least one creature token.
1323-3143-4644-4762.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a -1/-1 counter from Experiment Kraj, creating a copy of any creature token you control.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Tidewater Minion's second ability by tapping it, untapping Xavier Sal.
Repeat.

1012-3180-5220.description:
Cast Chamber Sentry either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Chamber Sentry enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Chamber Sentry on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

155-590-678-4279.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
155-590-678-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cathedral Sanctifier.
When Cathedral Sanctifier dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Cathedral Sanctifier from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Yawgmoth's ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Cast Cathedral Sanctifier by paying {0}.
When Cathedral Sanctifier enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat until you've drawn a sufficient number of cards.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cathedral Sanctifier, targeting Cathedral Sanctifier.
When Cathedral Sanctifier dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Cathedral Sanctifier from your graveyard to your hand.
Yawgmoth's ability from step 6 fizzles due to having no legal targets.
Cast Cathedral Sanctifier by paying {0}.
When Cathedral Sanctifier enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat from step 6.

678-2438-5173.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Shambling Ghast by paying {B}.
Repeat.

632-1978-4242-4659.notablePrerequisites: Scarecrone does not have summoning sickness.
632-1978-4242-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Scarecrone.
Repeat.

751-1012-2440.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other Drake.
751-1012-2440.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {1}.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {2}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

152-2793-4501.notablePrerequisites: Minimus Containment attached to Ugin's Nexus.
152-2793-4501.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Put the token Ugin's Nexus into exile due to the legend rule, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2012-2842-4050-5189.notablePrerequisites: Strangleroot Geist does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
2012-2842-4050-5189.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Strangleroot Geist, adding {1}.
Strangleroot Geist's undying ability and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Strangleroot Geist undying trigger, returning Strangleroot Geist from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing a player to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Strangleroot Geist, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2556-3557-4377.notablePrerequisites:
Brago does not have summoning sickness.
Brago can not be blocked.
2556-3557-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
Move to your combat phase.
Deal combat damage with Brago, blinking Mnemonic Wall.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

813-1283-1987.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first activated ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker for {3} targeting Chromatic Orrery and Scholar of the Ages, blinking them.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability any number of times.
